description: Defines the ParserInterface trait for parsing SQL-related strings into logical plans, expressions, identifiers, and schema types within Spark SQL's catalyst module.

classes.name: ParserInterface
classes.description: Trait defining methods for parsing SQL strings into various logical and data types within Spark SQL.

methods.name: parsePlan
methods.description: Parses a SQL string into a LogicalPlan.

methods.name: parsePlanWithParameters
methods.description: Parses a SQL string into a LogicalPlan with explicit parameter context, defaulting to parsePlan.

methods.name: parseExpression
methods.description: Parses a SQL string into an Expression.

methods.name: parseTableIdentifier
methods.description: Parses a SQL string into a TableIdentifier.

methods.name: parseFunctionIdentifier
methods.description: Parses a SQL string into a FunctionIdentifier.

methods.name: parseMultipartIdentifier
methods.description: Parses a SQL string into a sequence of identifier parts.

methods.name: parseQuery
methods.description: Parses a SQL string into a LogicalPlan representing a query.

methods.name: parseRoutineParam
methods.description: Parses a SQL string into a StructType for routine parameters.
